title: Restocking, Label Fee and Return Credit Schedule (Ship-To Fulfillment Account)
content:
**Ship-To Fulfillment Account — returns schedule, part two: fees deducted and credit issued.** Percentages apply to the returned extended amount as stated in each definition; amounts are USD.

| Service level | Restocking fee, customer-reason return of a stocked item (percent) | Minimum restocking fee per return line (USD) | Corbett-error returns carry no restocking fee | Restocking fee on an accepted special-order return (percent) | Credit for an opened unused item (percent, before any restocking fee) | Prepaid return label fee (USD) | Route truck pickup of customer-reason returns at no charge | Credit issued within (business days after receipt and inspection) | Return credit basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Corbett Parcel Ship-To | 20 | 15.00 | yes | 0 | 0 | 12.50 | no | 5 | invoiced unit price |
| Corbett Standard Ship-To | 15 | 10.00 | yes | 0 | 0 | 12.50 | no | 5 | invoiced unit price |
| Corbett Priority Ship-To | 15 | 10.00 | yes | 0 | 75 | 9.95 | no | 3 | invoiced unit price |
| Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To | 10 | 5.00 | yes | 0 | 75 | 0.00 | yes | 3 | invoiced unit price |
| Corbett Premier Route Ship-To | 10 | 5.00 | yes | 25 | 80 | 0.00 | yes | 2 | invoiced unit price |
| Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To | 0 | 0.00 | yes | 20 | 85 | 0.00 | yes | 2 | invoiced unit price |

### Definitions

- *Restocking fee* — the restocking fee, percent of the returned extended amount, on customer-reason returns of stocked items.
- *Minimum restocking fee* — the minimum restocking fee per return line when a restocking fee applies, USD.
- *Corbett-error returns* — whether returns for wrong item shipped, damaged in transit, defective or duplicate shipment carry no restocking fee.
- *Special-order restocking fee* — the restocking fee, percent, on an accepted special-order return (manufacturer restocking passed through).
- *Opened item credit* — the percent of the returned extended amount credited for an opened unused item before any restocking fee.
- *Return label fee* — the fee for a Corbett prepaid return label on a customer-reason return, deducted from the credit, USD.
- *Route pickup included* — whether Corbett picks up customer-reason returns on the route truck at no charge.
- *Credit issue period* — the business days after receipt and inspection within which the return credit is issued.
- *Return credit basis* — the unit price on which return credit is computed.

*Hypothetical reading:* at a level showing a 15 percent restocking fee, a 10.00 minimum and a 12.50 label fee, those three figures are the ones the returns rules apply to that ship-to's customer-reason returns.
